Wine tourism

What to do in the Agly Valley?

Between Perpignan and the Corbières, the Agly Valley blends wine villages, Cathar heritage and wild landscapes. Our guide to planning a day around a tasting at the cellar in Latour-de-France.

A typical day around Latour-de-France

Latour-de-France is about 20 km north-west of Perpignan. Our tip: book the cellar visit and natural wine tasting (1 h 30) in the morning or early afternoon, then spend the rest of the day in the valley. Time slots are available through online booking on Viny'aquí.

  • Maury

    A wine village on black schist soils, famed for its natural sweet wines. An obvious stop to understand the terroir of our vines.

    Our terroir

  • Tautavel

    Known worldwide for Tautavel Man and its European prehistory centre, Tautavel is also a winegrowing village where some of our plots grow.

    Our vineyard

  • Vingrau

    A village surrounded by vines at the foot of the Corbières, with the scrubland and limestone cliffs typical of the Agly Valley.

    The estate

  • Cathar castles

    A few dozen minutes from Latour-de-France, Quéribus and Peyrepertuse tower over the Corbières: a must-do for a day of wine and heritage.

  • Galamus Gorges

    A spectacular road cut into the rock, about 30 to 40 minutes from the cellar, ideal for a half-day outing.

Opening hours and visiting conditions of tourist sites: please check with each of them before you go.
